The '''1941-42 Serie A''' was the forty-second edition of the [[Italian Football Championship]] and the thirteenth since [[1929–30 Serie A|1929]] re-[[brand]]ing to create [[Serie A]]. It was the nineteenth season from which the Italian Football Champions adorned their team jerseys in the subsequent season with a [[Scudetto]]. [[AS Roma]] were champions for the first time in their [[history]] and the first Italian Football Championship won by a team from outside Northern Italy. This was thus also their first scudetto since the scudetto started being awarded in [[1923–24 Prima Divisione|1924]] and their first win contested as Serie A.
[[Image:Serie A (football) 1941-42.png|thumb|325px|right|Serie A 1941-42 teams distribution]]

==Teams==
[[Sampdoria|Liguria]] and [[Modena FC|Modena]] had been promoted from [[Serie B]].
